item.title: How and where do you sell your fonts?
item.description: I’m hoping to release my first font shortly and I’m curious how those more experienced in this niche go about the business of maximizing the revenue created by their work.

item.title: Marketing Business Font Identification
item.description:
I am having trouble determining the fonts in the logo image included. If someone could help me determine what fonts are used, I would greatly appreciated it.

Additionally: If they are commercial fonts, do you know of any free alternatives.

Thank you ahead of time.

item.title: How to market a newly released typeface?
item.description: I’ve just released my first paid font family via MyFonts, and I’m having trouble getting the word out about it. What’s the best way to approach this? Send images to blogs? I posted it in the release section here and didn’t get much feedback, any ideas?

item.title: About the Neue Frutiger 1450
item.description:
Hi,

I would be glad to have your opinion concerning the Neue Frutiger 1450 released by Monotype. I’ve also seen that they have published an article : " DIN 1450 – the German standard on legibility of texts" which could be seen as a marketing argument to justify, and sell this 1450 serie. (Maybe I’m wrong?).
